name: Ehud
description: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moab. Hid a short sword on his right thigh where no guard thought to check, then struck King Eglon (Judges 3:15-30).

left-hand-strike.name: The Left Hand
left-hand-strike.description: Drawing from the side no one watched
left-hand-strike.prompt: drawing a short double-edged sword from under his cloak with his LEFT hand in one quick fluid motion, weight forward, eyes locked on the target

hidden-blade.name: Nothing to See
hidden-blade.prompt: walking calmly through a palace doorway past armed guards, cloak draped over his right thigh concealing the blade, slight knowing half-smile

rallying-horn.name: Rallying the Hills
rallying-horn.description: Sounding the shofar after the escape
rallying-horn.prompt: standing on a hilltop in Ephraim blowing a ram's horn shofar, left fist raised, Israelites rallying behind him below
